ValidationRule.description: Either Customer ID or Bill To Site Numbers are Mandatory
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND( $RecordType.Name=='NCSP: DP New Customer Setup', NOT(ISBLANK(Setup_Complete_Date__c)), (ISBLANK(Customer_ID__c) && ISBLANK(Bill_To_Site_Number__c)) ), AND( $RecordType.Name=='NCSP: Upsell', (NOT(CONTAINS( TEXT(Origin),"IMLA") && ISPICKVAL( Status,"New") )), (ISBLANK(Customer_ID__c) && ISBLANK(Bill_To_Site_Number__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Setup_Complete_Date__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please select either Customer Id or Bill to Site Number.
